_comment: Artwork the app ships for 2010 in place of its season pack (Export-SeasonCosmetics.ps1 from the pack). Skin-pack files land under Seasons/2010/ when the player imports it; helmet and visor sponsor layers are built then from the pack's helmets. Teams with hand-painted liveries in the pack race on the generic kit: none.
